author: GitHub
description:
Think you need to be a coding genius to contribute to open source? Think again. Open source projects rely heavily on help with documentation, fixing typos, adding examples, and answering questions. You actually level up your skills by contributing, not before. Watch this short to learn why you belong in the open source community, and check out GitHub for beginners on our channel for more tips: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r8jQ9hVA2qs&list=PL0lo9MOBetEFcp4SCWinBdpml9B2U25-f
